_comment: Source of truth for the Design tab's table: the object-driven tool offer, its Speed Dial actions and its
Every verb, the selections it accepts, the document state it needs, and its fixed
compass address. Extracted from the code, not from memory:
call sites at 524/662/734/790/874/904, sk_key table at 369-400, m_keys_feature)
Design commands            -> a verb's `tool` block, and the entries with no slot (commands only):
the silent form's access, params and examples; Mcp/Tools/Design*.cpp bind each block to its function
operations                 -> the operations of GUI/Operations a command that changes Prepare reaches
gen_offer_table.py emits src/slic3r/GUI/CAD/DesignOffer.hpp from this file, so the map
exists once. Edit the atlas and regenerate; never hand-edit the header.

slots.label: Create
slots.why: makes new geometry from nothing you have yet

slots.label: Remove
slots.why: takes material away Shell lives here by decision of 2026-08-01, not by oversight.

slots.label: Fillet / chamfer / draft
slots.why: finishes faces and edges without changing the shape's intent; named for the tools it holds, not for the trade word. RATIFIED 2026-08-01: Shell stays in Remove and Delete Face in Modify — this row is deliberately NOT the same set as the toolbar's dressup dropdown, which groups all five. Shell hollows a solid, so it belongs with the verbs that take material away. Do not re-open: a verb's row is its address and reordering breaks learned reach.

slots.label: Modify
slots.why: edits or removes what is already there

slots.label: Top
slots.why: the verbs a selection is opened for most. A flat slot is not a family: its verbs sit first, at the top level of the offer, each an item of its own, and its label is never shown. Appended last, so no ratified index moved.

tool.summary: Draw a shape in the open sketch from its fields beside `type`, or a list of shapes as `entities`.
tool.details: Each type, and the fields it takes: line {p0, p1}; polyline {points: 2 or more, a loop when the last is the first}; rectangle_2_point {p0, p1: opposite corners}; rectangle_center {center, corner}; rectangle_3_point {p0, p1: one side; width: signed, to the left of p0 to p1}; rectangle_rounded {p0, p1: opposite corners; radius: of the corners}; circle_center {center, radius}; circle_2_point {p0, p1: the ends of a diameter}; circle_3_point {p0, p1, p2: on the circle}; arc_3_point {p0: start; p1: end; on_arc}; arc_center {center, radius, start_angle, end_angle}; arc_tangent {end; entity: the line or arc it leaves, the sketch's or one an item before it adds, at that one's end, along its direction there, left out the one added last}; slot {c0, c1, width}; slot_arc {center, start, end: its direction from the centre, width}; ellipse {center, radius (semi-major), rminor, rotation}; ellipse_arc {the ellipse's fields, start_angle, end_angle: parametric, counter-clockwise}; spline {ctrl: 2 or more poles}; polygon {center, sides, radius (to a vertex) or across_flats, angle (of that vertex, or of the first edge's midpoint)}; point {p}. A type refuses a field it does not take. Each is built as its drawing tool builds it: a rectangle, a slot or a polygon is one shape, which one undo of the sketch takes off whole, and a polyline is its lines, as its tool leaves them; the constraints are inferred exactly, so that none moves what is given. Each shape carries the constraints its tool gives it, at any slant; a constraint between a shape and the sketch's axes or what is already in the sketch, or between plain lines, is inferred only where it holds exactly, so a square on the axes is level only on a side lying exactly on one, with right angles holding the others. Each item of entities may carry its own construction; the top-level construction is the single-type form's, and beside entities each item's that gives none. Beside entities a shape's field, type among them, is refused: it belongs in its item. Points are [x, y] in the sketch plane (mm); angles are radians, or degrees as start_angle_deg and the like. A polygon is lines; its side count is not kept once committed. Reply: first_index, added, shapes [{first, count}] per item, entities, dof.

The menu-item forms then act on the selection: feature_edit, design_rename_selected, feature_delete and sketch_constrain_selected called with no arguments act on the selected row of the Feature list while nothing is picked in the view, and design_zoom_to_selection acts on what is picked in the view, so a sketch is zoomed to through sketch with loop, not through feature.
